crossRefs.note: James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came near to him, saying, “Teacher, we want you to do for us whatever we will ask.”
Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with…
Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.
There were also women watching from afar, among whom were both Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less…
They came into the house and saw the young child with Mary, his mother, and they fell down and worshiped him. Opening…
Behold, a leper came to him and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”
Those who were in the boat came and worshiped him, saying, “You are truly the Son of God!”
But she came and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, help me.”
When they saw him, they bowed down to him, but some doubted.

people.name: Zebedee

translations.web: Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to him with her sons, kneeling and asking a certain thing of him.
translations.bsb: Then the mother of Zebedee’s sons came to Jesus with her sons and knelt down to make a request of Him.
translations.kjv: Then came to him the mother of Zebedee's children with her sons, worshipping him, and desiring a certain thing of him.
translations.asv: Then came to him the mother of the sons of Zebedee with her sons, worshipping him, and asking a certain thing of him.
